evidence: LC n83067154 identifies Faye Evelyn Dudden (born 1948), author of Serving Women and Women in the American Theatre. LC n79045336 identifies Frederick Homes Dudden (1874-1955), author of Gregory the Great. These are distinct authorities and careers, not duplicate records.

LC n90651658 identifies Elizabeth Harvey (born 1957), historian of Weimar and Nazi Germany. LC n84125301 identifies Elizabeth Ruth Harvey (born 1944), editor of The Court of Sapience and author of The Inward Wits. Different birth dates, publications and specialisms establish distinct people, not duplicate authorities.

LC n82057802 identifies Peter Taylor (born 1942), television reporter and author of Beating the Terrorists? and books on Northern Ireland. LC n84044600 identifies Peter James Taylor (born 1944), geographer at Newcastle and Northumbria, author of Political Geography. The authorities describe different careers, not duplicates.

a combines Cornish Carols (1929) with Roman papyrology: the Vindolanda report is by Alan Bowman and J. David Thomas. b also mixes people: its Neolithic archaeology differs from The Informal Media Economy, whose Julian Thomas was at Swinburne. Moreover, b's LC nb2006007766 documents Julian Edward Thomas and a childhood Helicobacter thesis, not the listed archaeology books.

Hall (born 1936; LC n50017927). b's Medieval Fields, Fenland surveys and The Open Fields of England concern English landscape archaeology. LC nb2011013207 has a David Hall born 1938; it is not a duplicate identification of the Harvard historian.

Hall's Immigration and the Educational Test (1897). a's main career is planner Peter Geoffrey Hall (1932-2014; LC n50018664).
